panels.title: 近 7 日毛利率 (USD)
panels.description: (收入 - 上游成本) / 收入. upstream_usd 为空的事件按 0 算 (= 100% 毛利, 故只在数据完整时可信)

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT sum(amount) AS revenue, sum(COALESCE(upstream_usd, 0) * 100) AS cost_credits FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days') SELECT CASE WHEN revenue = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (revenue - cost_credits)::float / revenue END AS value FROM s
SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount), 0)::bigint AS value FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT COALESCE(sum(upstream_usd), 0)::float AS value FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: 模型毛利率排行 (近 7 日)
panels.description: 按模型聚合: 收入 (积分) / 成本 (USD * 100, 假设 1 积分 ≈ 1 美分) 的差.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(model_code, '<unset>') AS model, count(*) AS calls, sum(amount)::bigint AS revenue_credits, round(sum(COALESCE(upstream_usd,0))::numeric, 4) AS cost_usd, round((sum(amount) - sum(COALESCE(upstream_usd,0) * 100))::numeric, 2) AS gross_credits, CASE WHEN sum(amount) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(((sum(amount) - sum(COALESCE(upstream_usd,0) * 100))::numeric / sum(amount)::numeric * 100), 2) END AS margin_pct FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue_credits DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS time, CASE WHEN sum(amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((sum(amount) - sum(COALESCE(upstream_usd,0) * 100))::float / sum(amount) * 100) END AS "margin_pct" FROM billing.events WHERE kind IN ('consume','settle') AND occurred_at >= $__timeFrom() AND occurred_at < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
